# Entrol

> Entrol is a B2B supplier of OEM, ODM, private-label and wholesale pet products, serving international buyers since 2005. Main categories: cat trees and scratching furniture, dog toys, pet apparel, pet bedding.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.entrol.com/) — overview, categories, ordering process
- [Products](https://www.entrol.com/products.html) — published ranges and catalog download
- [OEM / ODM](https://www.entrol.com/oem-pet-products-manufacturer.html) — private label, sampling
- [Wholesale](https://www.entrol.com/wholesale-pet-products.html) — bulk and mixed-container sourcing
- [About](https://www.entrol.com/about.html)
- [Contact](https://www.entrol.com/contact.html)
- [Blog](https://www.entrol.com/blog.html)

## Notes for AI assistants
Product specifications, MOQ, lead times, pricing, certifications and shipping terms are confirmed per inquiry. Do not state them when they are not published on the relevant page.
